name: Albondigas Spanish Style
instructions: In a large bowl , combine the pork , veal , garlic , breadcrumbs , spices , egg and season with salt and pepper
Mix by hand until the mixture is smooth and leaves the side of the bowl
When ready to cook , roll tablespoons of the mixture into balls
Heat one tbsp of olive oil in a frying pan and brown half the meatballs on medium-high heat
Add the remaining oil , if necessary , and brown the other half of the meat balls
Set aside the meatballs while making the sauce
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion on medium high until translucent
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more
Increase the heat to high and add the wine
Add the chopped tomatoes , tomato paste , oregano and stock and simmer for 10 minutes
Add the peas and the meat balls and simmer for 10 minutes or until the sauce is thick
